summary: Tightened the prose, stamped all status claims 'as of August 2026', dated the concluded vera.ai, PROMPT and EACEA roles, added the omitted European Parliament written-question citation, toned down the media-coverage framing to the sourced facts, and cut the unsourced closing filler.

flags.claim: Fabio Giglietto is a Full Professor of Internet Studies
flags.issue: The authoritative biography stamps this and other status claims 'as of August 2026'; the biography renders them as timeless present tense. Fixed by adding the date stamp to status statements (professorship, MINE activity, memberships).

flags.claim: In addition to evaluating project proposals as an independent expert for the European Education and Culture Executive Agency
flags.issue: Present-tense phrasing implies an open-ended ongoing role; the authoritative biography states the EACEA appointment ran to September 2026, stamped as of August 2026. Fixed by dating the appointment.

flags.claim: his recent empirical work on platform algorithms and political content visibility has attracted significant domestic media attention
flags.issue: The authoritative biography supports only that the 2025 Meta working paper drew national media coverage in the named outlets between January and April 2026; 'significant' and the broader framing are the writer's intensification. Rewritten to match the source's scope.

flags.claim: coverage appearing in outlets such as Il Sole 24 Ore, Il Resto del Carlino, Open, and Lumsanews
flags.issue: The biography omits the authoritative biography's fact that the 2025 Meta working paper was cited in a written question to the European Commission (European Parliament, 2026). Added to revised_html. Note: the vivereurbino.it web mention's claims of a Rai 3 'Report' feature and 'European Parliament inquiries' must NOT be used — the biography correctly avoided them and the revision keeps only the authoritative-biography-supported citation fact.

flags.claim: serving as a work package leader for the vera.ai project
flags.issue: The authoritative biography states vera.ai concluded in October 2025 and PROMPT in February 2026; the biography leaves both undated, blurring the completed-event/status distinction. Dates added.

flags.claim: Through these collaborative networks and his ongoing research, he continues to investigate how digital platforms shape public discourse and the systemic challenges of information governance.
flags.issue: Empty closing abstraction that asserts an undated ongoing activity and adds no sourced fact; removed in the revision.

flags.claim: To support the broader academic community, he maintains active memberships in several international organizations
flags.issue: Filler framing ('to support the broader academic community') not supported by any source, and memberships stated as timeless rather than as of August 2026; rewritten and stamped.
